data.title: Vida Residences Club Point
data.about:
Vida Residences Club Point at Dubai Hills Estate is a new project by Emaar. It offers a blend of style, convenience, and tranquility. This development consists of two contemporary towers with elegant architectural design, nestled within lush, landscaped gardens. It provides 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments with spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and sleek, modern finishes.

Residents can enjoy stunning views of the championship golf course, expansive parklands, and Dubai’s iconic skyline. Designed for young professionals and those who appreciate a vibrant and dynamic lifestyle, Vida Residences Club Point Dubai Hills Estate reflects the sophisticated spirit of Vida Hotels & Resorts, creating a community that fosters creativity, comfort, and convenience.

characteristics_module.title: Discover Unmatched Elegance and Lifestyle
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Nestled in Dubai Hills Estate, offering a perfect balance of urban convenience and tranquil surroundings, with easy access to key areas like Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina.
  • Breathtaking Views: Enjoy stunning vistas of the championship golf course, lush parklands, and the city’s iconic skyline from the comfort of your home.
  • World-Class Amenities: From adult and kids’ pools to a rooftop cinema and state-of-the-art gym, Vida Residences provides everything needed for a modern and active lifestyle.
  • Sophisticated Design: Contemporary architectural design featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, elegant finishes, and landscaped gardens, delivering both style and comfort.
  • Dynamic Living: A vibrant environment crafted for young professionals and families who value a connected, community-oriented lifestyle, complete with social spaces and outdoor leisure options.

image.name: Vida Residences Club Point Dubai Hills Estate

location_tile.title: Located Within the Green Heart of Dubai
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Situated in Dubai Hills Estate, the green heart of Dubai, Vida Residences offers residents the best of both worlds—serene natural surroundings and easy access to the city’s bustling attractions.

The community is strategically located between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina, ensuring proximity to Dubai’s most vibrant areas. The property is also just a 20-minute drive from Downtown Dubai and 25 minutes from Dubai International Airport, making it ideal for those who need quick and convenient access to key destinations.

  • Dubai Hills Mall: 5 Minutes
  • King’s College Hospital: 5 Minutes
  • Downtown Dubai: 20 Minutes
  • Dubai International Airport: 25 Minutes
